t: This is All Souls Church in Langham Place, at the north end of Regent Street in Marylebone. It's a conservative evangelical Anglican church, designed in the Regency style by John Nash and consecrated in 1824. Nash was a Georgian and Regency architect who shaped many important areas of London, with his work financed by the Prince Regent and the developer James Burton. Look up at the building and you're seeing his Regency design in one of the best-known spots on Regent Street.
